title: Neko's Memory Warning
description: A simple mod to warn you in case your Java memory is insufficient. Meant for modpack developers. Fully configurable.
body:
![system dialogue](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21bccd0767b14d1c66c29fe2173b7e12952e5a9a.png)

A simple mod that sends a system dialogue or a chat message (or a minecraft screen warning WIP) when the allocated memory is above or below a configurable threshold. This is meant for modpack developers. The config is at config/nekosmemorywarming-common and is also accessible via in-game client menu.

Tested on Linux and Windows 11
(the system pop-up probably doesn't work on MacOS)

Configuration options:
- Disable Warning
- Enable System Dialogue
- Enable Operator Message (on join)
- Minimum Warning Title
- Minimum Warning Message
- Maximum Warning Title
- Maximum Warning Message
- Minimum Memory
- Maximum Memory
- Recommended Memory
- Maximum Title Length
- Maximum Message Length
